summary: Iteration 20 short retest of the OTP/tenant fix. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (one quote test was skipped on the first run because it hit the OTP rate limit while running in parallel; it passed when re-run on its own). POST /api/auth/otp/request with X-Tenant-ID demo-jeweller-002 returns jeweller_id 002 and is_new_user=false for 9845678903. Verify logs in Rohan, and the JWT jeweller_id is 002. An invalid header or body jeweller_id returns 400 'This store is not available'. With no header the default is Sharma (001). The Sharma phone 9876543210 under the Patel header shows is_new_user=true, so stores stay separate. The Patel buy quote (13848.50) matches Patel /price and not Sharma (13948.50). Customer app at 390x844: after picking Patel in the side menu, Sign In with 9845678903 sends X-Tenant-ID 002 on request and verify. Rohan logs straight into Patel's home (no 'Complete your profile'), with 3.4970g held and ₹13,848.50/g. The Vault screen shows 'Patel Jewellery House'. After logout, switching to Sharma and logging in 9876543210 lands Aarav on Sharma's home at ₹13,948.50/g. Master panel top chip shows 'Gold ₹13,848.50/g · Silver ₹179.13/g' (2 decimals).

minor.issue: body.jeweller_id/body.tenant can still override the challenge's jeweller_id. is_new_user from /otp/request is computed for the challenge store, so a different tenant at verify could silently create a 'Gold' customer in another store and skip the profile step. Suggest binding verify to c.jeweller_id only.

issues: Shows 3.4970g held but the Transaction Passbook says 'No transactions yet', and P&L is +234.6% (avg ₹4,014.68/g). This looks like seed data: the holdings have no ledger rows. Not a regression.

action_items: Optional: in otp_verify, ignore body.tenant/jeweller_id (or reject a mismatch) and use the challenge's jeweller_id
Optional: seed ledger transactions for Rohan Gupta (Patel) so the vault passbook matches his holdings
critical_code_review_comments: otp_request change is correct: it checks for an active store and falls back to the default store only when no jeweller is given
The frontend api.ts already sends X-Tenant-ID on every request, so login.tsx needs no body change
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP request is rate-limited to 5 per minute per phone, so wait 60s between repeated pytest runs. The side menu slides in, so wait about 1.2s before clicking side-menu-store-picker. The master login username input has no type attribute; use input nth(0).
rca_of_issue: Iteration 19 HIGH bug (OTP ignored the store picked in the app) is fixed: otp_request now reads body.jeweller_id, then the X-Tenant-ID header.
